properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-29, the recall pilot (blind-scored, one run per arm): reflow2 25 of 25, notes file 24.5, read-everything 25, hand-forward summary 13.5; reflow2 cost 2.2× the notes file's tokens; 4 of 5 predictions held, the cue-following count is still owed
properties.source: Blind scorer (Opus subagent) against the key; costs from subagent usage; calls from the arm C wrapper log
properties.statement:
Run 2026-10-29 07:00–08:10 UTC, Claude Sonnet for every agent, protocol and predictions fixed before the first run (reflow2:fact:predictions-for-the-recall-pilot-registered-before-any-run-2026-10-29). Scored blind by an Opus agent against the key, arms relabelled at random (mapping kept apart).

SCORES (of 25; cite = names an establishing document):
- C reflow2 (local 0.93.1 through a logging wrapper): 25.0, cite 25.
- D one agent reading all 60 documents: 25.0, cite 25.
- B notes file: 24.5, cite 25 (half a point on Q15, a what-breaks-if).
- A hand-forward summary of at most 1,500 words: 13.5, cite 18. By category: current values 7.5/8, why 0.5/5, what-breaks-if 1.5/5, contradictions 2/4, sums 2/3.

COST (subagent tokens, all rounds): A 443k, B 576k, C 1,246k, D 102k. reflow2's rounds grew as the design grew: 93k, 151k, 185k, 208k, 241k, 202k, answering 164k; the notes file's stayed 58k–103k. reflow2 calls: 812, of which 75 refused (9%); describe_schema called 74 times.

RECALL (arm C): every session opened with get_instructions (as its prompt said); a served skill was fetched 2 times in 7 sessions; loop_status 6 times. Whether the cues in reflow2's replies were followed is NOT yet counted.

PREDICTIONS: P1 (D ≥ 21) held. P2 (C beats A by ≥ 4) held, by 11.5. P3 (C and B within 3) held, 0.5 apart. P4 first half (skills fetched in at most 2 of 6 rounds) held; second half (cues followed) owed. P5 (C ≥ 30% more tokens than B) held, 2.2×.

WHAT IT MEANS, and what it does not: on a project that fits in one context (~22,000 tokens of documents), a notes file that grows to the size of the documents does as well as reflow2 at under half the cost; a short summary loses the why, the chains and the contradictions. Structure did not show a scoring advantage here because nothing forced it to; this is the regime Anthony predicted favours notes (reflow2:dec:idea-measure-where-structure-starts-to-matter-size-against-context-and-graph-against-notes). One run per arm: a difference under 3 points is noise.

ALSO FOUND: the reflow2 arm (and two others) flagged a real open problem the key missed: the inverter's PV input limit of 12 kWp (D47) against a 17.6 kWp array. The key also lacks a possible VFD-loss contradiction (D29 vs D56). Material, answers and scores: scratchpad recall-exp/ and recall-key/ of session 5c7a072b.
Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
